periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented at a downward diagonal angle approximately 45 degrees from the horizontal facial midline towards the lateral cheeks.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit an elongated teardrop or vertical oval profile where the vertical height exceeds the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a noticeable downward elongation, with the patch tapering significantly towards its lower-lateral boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the dark band across the shoulders displays a shallow, broad U-shaped curvature.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is relatively thick, covering approximately 30-35% of the visible vertical height of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are positioned wide apart on the crown, separated by a distance roughly equal to two times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior edges of the ears are highly rounded and semicircular with no visible flattening.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow staining of the abdominal and ventral pelage compared to the cleaner white fur on the head and neck.
